 Function CalculateAge

Kind: Function
Name: CalculateAge
Access: Public

-
Declaration:

Public Shared Function CalculateAge(birthDate As Date, Optional asOfDate As Date? = Nothing) As Integer

-
Comment:


Calculates the age (in full years) based on a date of birth.

The patient's date of birth.
The reference date to calculate the age from. Defaults to today if not specified.
An integer representing the age in completed years.

This method accounts for whether the birthday has occurred yet in the current year.
If the current month and day are before the birth month and day, one year is subtracted.

For example:
- DOB: April 7, 2000 — As of April 6, 2025 → Age = 24
- DOB: April 7, 2000 — As of April 7, 2025 → Age = 25

This mirrors legacy behavior from the original VBA function 'return_age_int_fnc'.


-
Properties:
NameValue
 DocComment <summary> Calculates the age (in full years) based on a date of birth. </summary> <param name="birthDate">The patient's date of birth.</param> <param name="asOfDate">The reference date to calculate the age from. Defaults to today if not specified.</param> <returns>An integer representing the age in completed years.</returns> <remarks> This method accounts for whether the birthday has occurred yet in the current year. If the current month and day are before the birth month and day, one year is subtracted. For example: - DOB: April 7, 2000 — As of April 6, 2025 → Age = 24 - DOB: April 7, 2000 — As of April 7, 2025 → Age = 25 This mirrors legacy behavior from the original VBA function 'return_age_int_fnc'. </remarks>
 FullNameEZLogger.Helpers.AgeHelper.CalculateAge

Public Sub CloseActiveDocument(Optional showPrompt As Boolean = False)

-
Comment:


Closes the active Word document with optional prompt to user.
Defaults to silent close without prompting to save.


If True, user is asked whether to save changes.
If False, the document is closed without any dialog.

 Sub PopulateDueDates

Kind: Sub
Name: PopulateDueDates
Access: Public

-
Declaration:

Public Sub PopulateDueDates(view As DueDates1370View)

-
Comment:


Populates due dates and related labels in the provided ReportTypeView based on the active Word document.

The ReportTypeView instance containing the controls to update.

The function is triggered when the user selects the button that says I selected the report type
This function retrieves custom properties from the active Word document, such as "Classification" and "Expiration",
and uses them to calculate and populate various due dates. If the classification is "PC1370", extended due dates
are calculated. Otherwise, standard due dates are determined based on the commitment date.
If no active document is found or required properties are missing, appropriate labels are updated to reflect this.


-
Properties:
NameValue
 DocComment <summary> Populates due dates and related labels in the provided ReportTypeView based on the active Word document. </summary> <param name="view">The ReportTypeView instance containing the controls to update.</param> <remarks> The function is triggered when the user selects the button that says I selected the report type This function retrieves custom properties from the active Word document, such as "Classification" and "Expiration", and uses them to calculate and populate various due dates. If the classification is "PC1370", extended due dates are calculated. Otherwise, standard due dates are determined based on the commitment date. If no active document is found or required properties are missing, appropriate labels are updated to reflect this. </remarks>

 Function GetFilePart

Kind: Function
Name: GetFilePart
Access: Public

-
Declaration:

Public Function GetFilePart(choice As Integer, Optional filePath As String = Nothing) As String

-
Comment:


Extracts a portion of the file path based on the specified choice.


1 = Base file name (no extension, remove extra dots) [default] 

2 = File extension only 

3 = Full file path


Optional: If not provided, uses the currently active Word document's full path.

The requested file name part as a string.

Dim baseName = FileNameHelper.GetFilePart(1) ' Returns "Report_123"
Dim ext = FileNameHelper.GetFilePart(2)      ' Returns ".docx"
Dim fullPath = FileNameHelper.GetFilePart(3) ' Returns "C:\Reports\Report_123.docx"


-
Properties:
NameValue
 DocComment <summary> Extracts a portion of the file path based on the specified choice. </summary> <param name="choice"> 1 = Base file name (no extension, remove extra dots) [default] <br/> 2 = File extension only <br/> 3 = Full file path </param> <param name="filePath"> Optional: If not provided, uses the currently active Word document's full path. </param> <returns>The requested file name part as a string.</returns> <example> Dim baseName = FileNameHelper.GetFilePart(1) ' Returns "Report_123" Dim ext = FileNameHelper.GetFilePart(2) ' Returns ".docx" Dim fullPath = FileNameHelper.GetFilePart(3) ' Returns "C:\Reports\Report_123.docx" </example>

 Module FormPositionHelper

Name: FormPositionHelper
Access: Public

-
Declaration:

Public Module FormPositionHelper

-
Comment:


Provides helper methods to position WinForms forms in a multi-monitor environment.


This module is designed to assist in positioning forms relative to the virtual desktop,
which spans across all connected monitors. It is particularly useful for applications
that need to ensure forms are displayed in consistent locations regardless of the monitor setup.


-
Properties:
NameValue
 DocComment <summary> Provides helper methods to position WinForms forms in a multi-monitor environment. </summary> <remarks> This module is designed to assist in positioning forms relative to the virtual desktop, which spans across all connected monitors. It is particularly useful for applications that need to ensure forms are displayed in consistent locations regardless of the monitor setup. </remarks>
 FullNameEZLogger.FormPositionHelper
 IsShadowsFalse
 NamespaceEZLogger
 XmlDocComment

None

Name: MoveFormToTopLeftOfAllScreens
Access: Public

-
Declaration:

Public Sub MoveFormToTopLeftOfAllScreens(form As Form, Optional leftOffset As Integer = 0, Optional topOffset As Integer = 0)

-
Comment:


Moves the specified form to a position relative to the top-left corner of the virtual desktop,
with optional X/Y offset support.

The WinForms form to move.
Horizontal offset in pixels from the left edge of the virtual desktop.
Vertical offset in pixels from the top edge of the virtual desktop.

Dim myForm As New Form()
FormPositionHelper.MoveFormToTopLeftOfAllScreens(myForm, 10, 20)


This method sets the form's start position to manual and calculates its position
based on the virtual screen's top-left corner. It ensures the form is placed
correctly even in multi-monitor setups.


-
Properties:
NameValue
 DocComment <summary> Moves the specified form to a position relative to the top-left corner of the virtual desktop, with optional X/Y offset support. </summary> <param name="form">The WinForms form to move.</param> <param name="leftOffset">Horizontal offset in pixels from the left edge of the virtual desktop.</param> <param name="topOffset">Vertical offset in pixels from the top edge of the virtual desktop.</param> <example> Dim myForm As New Form() FormPositionHelper.MoveFormToTopLeftOfAllScreens(myForm, 10, 20) </example> <remarks> This method sets the form's start position to manual and calculates its position based on the virtual screen's top-left corner. It ensures the form is placed correctly even in multi-monitor setups. </remarks>

Defines the configuration options for displaying custom message boxes
in EZLogger. This class is used by MsgBoxHelper to control which
buttons (Yes, No, Ok) should be shown and what message should be

 Sub LaunchDueDates1370View

Kind: Sub
Name: LaunchDueDates1370View
Access: Public

-
Declaration:

Public Sub LaunchDueDates1370View()

-
Comment:


Launch the dueDates1370View window and populates it with
relevant data from the active Word document

This function manually constructs and initializes the
DueDates1370View and its host form (DueDates1370Host).  It
retrieves the "Commitment" custom document property and sets
the CommitmentDateLbl in the view. If the "early_nintey_day"
flag is set in the document, it also makes the Early 90DayLbl
visible. Form layout and position are explicitly set in the
handler to ensure proper display bypassing the usual Form_load
logic in the host form. The DueDate1370Handler is called to
populate the view with calculated due dates.


-
Properties:
NameValue
 DocComment<summary> Launch the dueDates1370View window and populates it with relevant data from the active Word document</summary> <remarks> This function manually constructs and initializes the DueDates1370View and its host form (DueDates1370Host). It retrieves the "Commitment" custom document property and sets the CommitmentDateLbl in the view. If the "early_nintey_day" flag is set in the document, it also makes the Early 90DayLbl visible. Form layout and position are explicitly set in the handler to ensure proper display bypassing the usual Form_load logic in the host form. The DueDate1370Handler is called to populate the view with calculated due dates. </remarks>

 Sub ShowBtnEMessage

Kind: Sub

Access: Public

-
Declaration:

Public Async Sub ShowBtnEMessage(patientNumber As String)

-
Comment:


Looks up the CONREP provider value in the HLV Excel workbook using the provided patient number.
Displays a busy indicator during processing. If a match is found, the provider value is saved
to the current Word document's custom properties under the key "CONREP".

The patient number used as a lookup key in the HLV Excel workbook.

This method runs the Excel lookup on a background thread using Tasks.Task.Run to avoid blocking the UI.
It shows a BusyHost form with an indeterminate progress bar during the lookup.
If a provider is found, it is written to the custom document property "CONREP".


-
Properties:
NameValue
 DocComment <summary> Looks up the CONREP provider value in the HLV Excel workbook using the provided patient number. Displays a busy indicator during processing. If a match is found, the provider value is saved to the current Word document's custom properties under the key "CONREP". </summary> <param name="patientNumber">The patient number used as a lookup key in the HLV Excel workbook.</param> <remarks> This method runs the Excel lookup on a background thread using Tasks.Task.Run to avoid blocking the UI. It shows a BusyHost form with an indeterminate progress bar during the lookup. If a provider is found, it is written to the custom document property "CONREP". </remarks>

Declaration:

Public Function LoadAllActive() As List(Of TCARRecord)

-
Comment:


Retrieves all active TCAR records from the database.

A list of  objects representing active TCAR records.

This function connects to the SQL database, executes a query to fetch records
where the "active" field is set to 1, and maps the results to a list of TCARRecord objects.
If an error occurs during database access, an error message is displayed to the user.


-

If an error occurs during database access, an error message is displayed to the user. </remarks>

The Word document (optional, used for metadata if needed later).
